## Trigger

When a repository runs the engine and a person sets the prefix with the kit config command, I want both the engine and the kit to mint under that one value, so I can set the prefix once and trust every create.

## Context

payload.requirements: One home for the prefix; the other side reads it or refuses by name.
payload.title: the id prefix has two homes in an engine repo

payload.acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] update --status in_progress on a record with no holder is refused with the claim command.
- [ ] fsck or stats names every existing in_progress record with no holder.
payload.description:
## Trigger

When a record moves to in_progress without a claim, I want the tracker to refuse it or name it, so I can trust that every record in progress has a person who holds it.

## Context

Found 2026-09-25: basicly-n5jvhh was in_progress with no holder since 2026-08-27, while its own note said deferred. update --status in_progress does not require a holder, and no check lists such records.
payload.requirements: One rule for who holds a record in progress, called from update and from the check.
payload.title: a record can sit in progress with no holder

payload.acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] basicly skills-user writes a description line on every tool skill, taken from the first body paragraph.
- [ ] A tool skill whose body has no first paragraph is refused by name at build time.
- [ ] Repo-level .claude/skills output is byte-identical to today.
payload.description:
## Trigger

When skills-user installs a tool skill into the user skill folder, I want its frontmatter to carry a one-line description that says when to load it, so I can see from the listing alone when an agent should use the tool.

## Context

Request from the terminal owner, 2026-09-25. Today a user-invoked skill projects no description on a .claude root, so Claude Code lists tool-git as git, taken from the first body line. Agents in other sessions read that as broken. The description synthesized for .agents roots (09c02f15) says a human runs it by name, which is the wrong message here. Every one of the 25 tool skills already opens its body with a paragraph such as 'Find files by name, extension or type. Use it instead of find', and that paragraph can be the description. Scope: the skills-user projection only. Repo .claude/skills stays terse.
payload.requirements: One rule derives the description, and skills-user and its drift check both call it.
payload.title: skills-user writes a routing description on each tool skill

payload.description:
## Trigger

When an agent reassigns a record through basicly tracker write, I want assign to be recorded like every other write, so I can reassign without switching to the kit command.

## Context

2026-09-25: basicly tracker write -- assign refused with 'assign is not a write this tracker knows how to record'. The kit verb assign --to NAME --take worked. mirror._MIRRORED_WRITES has no assign entry.
payload.requirements: One translation entry; the holder rule stays in the kit.
payload.title: the engine write path refuses assign

payload.acceptance_criteria:

payload.description:
## Trigger

When a record returns to a status it held before, and the first event is in events-0001.jsonl while the repeat is in pending-main.jsonl, I want the landing scrub to accept the repeat, so I can merge a worktree after I set a record back to a status.

## Context

2026-09-25: basicly worktree merge refused with 'pending-main.jsonl: basicly-n5jvhh#ev-45a9285c01-2 does not re-mint from its own content'. scrub_ledger in src/basicly/tracker.py resets its generation counters for each file, but the kit mints a generation across the whole ledger.
payload.requirements: The scrub counts generations the way the kit mints them: across every ledger file in order.
payload.title: scrub refuses an event that repeats across two ledger files
